The test image shows a young soybean seedling with dark brown to black, irregularly shaped spots scattered across leaves. This is a leaf disease. Top candidates: Septoria_brown_spot, Bacterial_Blight, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Phyllosticta_leaf_spot.

Now viewing reference images one at a time, starting with my top candidates:
Good match context (young plants, dark spots). But the test image lacks the yellowing. Let me check Bacterial_Blight.
Bacterial Blight shows angular lesions with yellow halos - doesn't match the test image's discrete dark spots. Checking Frogeye_leaf_spot next.
Frogeye shows circular holes/gray centers with reddish borders - not matching the solid dark spots in test image. Checking Phyllosticta_leaf_spot.
Phyllosticta shows large blotchy lesions - not matching. The test image has many small, discrete dark spots. Let me check another Septoria reference and Bacterial_Pustule.
This Septoria reference shows exact same small dark irregular spots on a young leaf - very close match to the test image. Let me check Bacterial_Pustule to explore another candidate.
Bacterial Pustule shows brown granular pustule texture - very different. Checking Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus next.
Soybean Vein Necrosis shows large yellow-orange patches - not matching. My last reference view - checking the final Septoria reference to confirm.

This is a very strong match. The Septoria_brown_spot reference (Soybean_Dise_98.jpg) shows the exact same pattern: green leaf with numerous small, dark brown/black irregular spots scattered uniformly - identical to the test image.

**Summary of evidence:**
- Test image: young soybean seedling, both leaves covered with small, dark brown to black, irregularly shaped discrete spots
- Septoria_brown_spot references perfectly match: small dark irregular spots on green leaves of young plants, progressing to yellowing
- Bacterial Blight ruled out: angular lesions with yellow halos, not matching
- Frogeye ruled out: circular gray-centered lesions, not matching
- Phyllosticta ruled out: large blotchy lesions, not matching
- Bacterial Pustule ruled out: brown granular texture, not matching
- Vein Necrosis ruled out: large yellow-orange patches, not matching
